body:
Persistent AISquad (story_ai_form_squad, hand-authored at spawn); ai_squad_reevaluate compacts dead members + re-derives leader/flank/suppress roles from survivor order each tick; role bias layered onto existing combat AI via ai_squad_apply_role_bias. Two squads seeded for VOXWORLD encounter. Commit dd76739.
